const current = await eda.pcb_Drc.getCurrentRuleConfiguration();
await eda.pcb_Drc.saveRuleConfiguration(current.config, '嘉立创示例_默认规则配置', true);

_source.title: 设置为新建 PCB 默认设计规则配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 返回值为结果导向，重复设置相同的设计规则为默认设计规则也将返回 `true`
_source.example.text.0: 1. 读取当前配置并保存为自定义配置（作为待指定的默认配置）
_source.example.text.1: 2. 把它设置为新建 PCB 的默认设计规则配置

title: Set as the default design rule configuration for new PCBs
remarks.text.0: The return value is result-oriented. Repeatedly setting the same design rule as the default will also return `true`
